policy.behavioral_graph: Actual file/symbol implementation graph acyclic; reciprocal declared leaf data/fact edges permitted. Asset graph separate.
policy.write_authority: Read/query permissions never authorize arbitrary foreign mutable fields. Requests enter declared owning APIs/handlers; facts publish only after commit. Component recipe creation/configuration belongs the existing host capability installer, then the documented runtime writer.
